asset.name: CommandButton
asset.description: The async-aware action progressing through idle, pending, progress, success, failure, retry, and cancellation without the consumer writing any glue, while holding stable dimensions throughout.

requires.reason: Visual treatment and variants are inherited rather than duplicated.
Pending, success, failure, cancellation, and stale-result handling use the one shared async contract.

signatureMoment.description: The button acknowledges on the same frame it is pressed and holds its exact width through pending, success, and settle, so a toolbar never reflows while work is running.
